name: Vector
summary: This EA implements a momentum-based trading strategy using vector-based signal generation, likely leveraging multiple technical indicators to determine trade direction and strength. It systematically opens positions when momentum conditions align and manages them with predefined exit rules. The strategy focuses on capturing directional moves driven by market momentum shifts.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个基于动量的交易策略，使用向量信号生成机制，可能利用多个技术指标来确定交易方向和强度。当动量条件一致时系统性地开仓，并使用预定义的出场规则进行管理。该策略专注于捕捉由市场动量变化驱动的方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于动量策略概念，通过向量化的方式综合多个技术指标信号来生成交易决策。入场条件依赖于动量指标的组合判断，当多个信号方向一致时触发开仓操作，类似于向量叠加的原理增强了信号的可靠性。出场条件可能结合了固定止损止盈以及动量衰减的动态判断，当动量信号反转或减弱时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA可能采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式确定交易规模，但缺乏高级的资金管理模块如凯利公式或动态仓位调整。资金管理上依赖于止损来控制单笔风险，但未见明显的最大回撤限制或整体仓位上限机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在极端行情下的防护措施可能不足。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is based on a momentum strategy concept that synthesizes signals from multiple technical indicators in a vectorized manner to generate trading decisions. Entry conditions rely on combined momentum indicator assessments, triggering positions when multiple signals align in the same direction, similar to vector superposition which enhances signal reliability. Exit conditions likely combine fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels with dynamic momentum decay detection, closing positions when momentum signals reverse or weaken. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-equity-proportional methods, but lacks advanced money management modules such as Kelly criterion or dynamic position adjustment. Risk management relies on stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but there is no visible maximum drawdown limit or overall exposure cap mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear, but protective measures under extreme market conditions may be insufficient.
pros: 多指标向量合成信号提高了入场准确率，减少了虚假信号
策略逻辑结构清晰，模块化设计便于理解和修改
动量策略在趋势明确的市场中表现良好，能捕捉中长期趋势行情
pros_en: Multi-indicator vector signal synthesis improves entry accuracy and reduces false signals
Strategy logic structure is clear with modular design for easy understanding and modification
Momentum strategy performs well in trending markets, capturing medium-to-long-term trend moves
cons: 动量策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损
缺乏高级资金管理模块，无法根据市场波动动态调整仓位
极端行情下止损可能被滑点穿透，风险控制存在漏洞
cons_en: Momentum strategy tends to generate frequent false signals and losses in ranging markets
Lacks advanced money management module, unable to dynamically adjust position size based on market volatility
Stop-losses may be penetrated by slippage under extreme market conditions, risk control has gaps
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动自动调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter to reduce trading frequency or pause trading during ranging conditions
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility

risk_points: 动量策略在震荡市中容易连续亏损，缺乏市场状态识别
固定止损可能无法适应不同波动环境，极端行情下滑点风险较大
risk_points_en: Momentum strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets without regime detection
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to varying volatility environments, slippage risk under extreme conditions

summary_en: This EA implements a momentum-based trading strategy using vector-based signal generation, likely leveraging multiple technical indicators to determine trade direction and strength. It systematically opens positions when momentum conditions align and manages them with predefined exit rules. The strategy focuses on capturing directional moves driven by market momentum shifts.
